quizName: Hardest Questions in Alaska Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: Which color is best for being seen on a motorcycle?
questions.explanation: Orange, red, yellow, and green clothing make you easier to see. Wear bright colors no matter what time of day you ride.

questions.question: What is the single most important thing you can do to survive a crash?

options.text: Wear a high-quality helmet that is securely fastened.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wear a high-quality helmet that is securely fastened.
questions.explanation: Wearing a high-quality helmet that is securely fastened is the most important thing you can do to improve your chances of surviving a crash.

questions.question: What is a benefit of wearing a leather jacket while riding?

options.text: Can make a rider look cool.
Is usually too warm to wear when riding.
Should not be worn when riding.

questions.explanation: Wear a long-sleeved leather jacket when riding for protection. Leather jackets can help protect you in hot weather and keep you cool while riding.

questions.question: How can you reduce head and neck injuries?
questions.explanation: A high-quality helmet greatly reduces the risk of head and neck injuries. A helmet is your best defense against injury in a crash.

questions.question: How can a motorcycle rider improve visibility?
questions.explanation: Wear brightly-colored clothing with reflective materials to be seen. Also use your headlight at all times and use your signals and brake light properly.

questions.question: Why should motorcycle riders wear gloves?

options.text: Not be worn because they will make your hands too hot.
Be worn to provide a better grip on the handgrips.
Not be worn because they will make it more difficult to work the controls.
Be worn only on cooler days.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be worn to provide a better grip on the handgrips.
questions.explanation: Wear leather gloves when riding. They improve your grip on the handgrips and protect your hands in a crash.

questions.question: What type of soles should motorcycle riding shoes have?

options.text: Are made of hard, durable, slip-resistant material.
Are made of soft, flimsy material.

questions.correctAnswerText: Are made of hard, durable, slip-resistant material.
questions.explanation: Wear high, sturdy boots or shoes that support your ankles. Choose footwear with hard, durable, slip-resistant soles.

questions.question: What material are motorcycle riding gloves usually made of?
questions.explanation: Motorcycle gloves are usually made of leather. They improve your grip and protect your hands and fingers.

questions.question: What removes alcohol and its effects from your body?
questions.explanation: Only time reduces your blood alcohol content. Coffee, exercise, fresh air, and cold showers cannot lower your blood alcohol content or make you sober. They may keep you awake, but they do not change the effects of alcohol.

questions.question: Which fabric provides the most protection for motorcyclists?
questions.explanation: Leather jackets and pants provide the best protection when riding.

questions.question: Your body can only get rid of alcohol through:
questions.explanation: Your body needs time to remove alcohol. There are no shortcuts to becoming sober.

questions.question: For riding safety, boots or shoes should:

options.text: Have long laces that are loose.
Cover the ankle and provide support.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover the ankle and provide support.
questions.explanation: Choose tall, sturdy boots or shoes that cover and support your ankles. Use low heels so they won't catch on anything. Tuck in long laces so they don't get caught in the motorcycle.

questions.question: A DOT-approved helmet:

options.text: Makes it harder to control your motorcycle.

questions.explanation: A helmet greatly reduces your risk of serious head or neck injury in a crash. A DOT-approved helmet will not limit your side vision.

questions.question: Your lane position should:

options.text: Hide your plans from other drivers.
Invite other drivers to share your lane.
Help you see and be seen better.
Keep you close to road signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Help you see and be seen better.
questions.explanation: A good lane position helps you see others and lets them see you. It also helps you avoid wind blasts, blind spots, and road hazards. It should discourage others from sharing your lane and give you an escape route if needed.

questions.question: Use a turn signal:

options.text: When you plan to speed up.
Only when there is heavy traffic.

questions.explanation: Always use a turn signal when you turn or change lanes, even if you think no one is watching.

questions.question: Even when your turn is obvious, you:

options.text: Only need to signal if pedestrians are nearby.
Only need to signal at a stop light.

questions.explanation: Always use a turn signal every time you turn or change lanes. Signals are important even if you think no one sees you. Other drivers may be nearby that you haven't noticed.

questions.question: To check tire pressure, you should:

options.text: Compare it to another tire's height.

questions.explanation: Use a tire gauge to check pressure before every ride. A tire that looks fine may actually be under-inflated, so looking at it is not enough.

questions.question: If a friend has had too much to drink and wants to ride, you should:

options.text: Tell them to ride on quiet roads.

questions.explanation: Never allow someone who has drunk too much to ride. Stop them by taking their keys if needed. Help them find another way to get home.

questions.question: Keeping space between your motorcycle and other vehicles:

options.text: Gives you time to react to driver mistakes.
Limits your movement in your lane.
Lets you rely on others to spot hazards.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gives you time to react to driver mistakes.
questions.explanation: Space around your motorcycle gives you time and room to react if another driver makes a mistake.

questions.question: As a motorcycle operator, you can help others see you by:
questions.explanation: To be more visible, wear bright clothing, keep your headlight on at all times, and always use your turn signals.

questions.question: To get the most protection from a helmet, choose one that:

options.text: Has been in a crash before.

questions.explanation: Choose a helmet that meets U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) and state standards. A good helmet should fit snugly all the way around your head.

questions.question: Which of these does NOT need to be checked regularly?
questions.explanation: Before every ride, check your motorcycle's tires, controls, chains, sprockets, shock absorbers, fasteners, and brakes. Small mechanical problems can be very dangerous on a motorcycle.

questions.question: Checking your mirrors:

options.text: Should only be done on long trips.
Should be part of your normal scanning routine.
Is not helpful since you can't change what is behind you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Should be part of your normal scanning routine.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors often as part of your normal routine. Also check mirrors before changing lanes, when stopping at an intersection, and before slowing down.

questions.question: When riding a motorcycle, clothing:

options.text: Should be loose enough to flap in the wind.
Should not cover your arms or legs completely.
Should not include a jacket if the weather is warm.
Can protect you if you crash.

questions.correctAnswerText: Can protect you if you crash.
questions.explanation: Proper clothing can protect you in a crash. Always wear a jacket and pants that cover your arms and legs completely, even in warm weather. Clothing should fit snugly but allow you to move freely.

questions.question: Proper motorcycle riding clothing should:

options.text: Cover your arms and legs completely.
Cover your arms completely, but leave your legs exposed.
Cover your legs completely, but leave your arms exposed.
Be whatever feels most comfortable, regardless of safety.

questions.correctAnswerText: Cover your arms and legs completely.
questions.explanation: Wear a jacket and pants that completely cover your arms and legs for proper protection while riding.
